overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board showed it periodically reviewed executive session minutes (March 13 and April 12, announced March 27 and April 24), and website posting is not legally required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to periodically review executive session minutes to determine whether they must be released to the public.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

allegations.summary: To the extent the complaint alleged the Board failed to post released executive session minutes to its website, the AG addressed the posting point.
allegations.key_passage: the Open Meeting Law does not require that meeting minutes be posted to a website or elsewhere

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
